script_text: Taurus, a celestial earthquake is reshaping the foundations of your steady Earth life. Monday through Wednesday, your ruling planet Venus squares Mars in your 5th House, making Monday worst for love conflicts. By Wednesday, Sun in your 3rd House trines Saturn in your 11th House, opening best career and money breakthroughs. The mid-week turning point hits Thursday as Mercury enters your 4th House, sextiling Jupiter in your 12th House. Thursday through Sunday, family focus dominates while Saturday's Venus trine Pluto in your 7th House deepens romantic commitment. Sunday's Sun opposition Pluto in your 10th House warns of career power struggles, so keep weekend plans soft. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Saturn in your 11th House, fusing love and income. Monday is your worst day because Mars squares Venus in your 5th House, inflaming romance. Audit finances before Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
